title: About Luna Classic (LUNC)
description: All about the latest scam of the moment, doing pump and dump with this useless token called Luna Classic. Be careful not to fall for it...

asr.full_text: I'm a LUNACLASSIC dude, let's talk about this! This Token here called T3RRA Classic, or LUNc which has now become the old LUNA after a death spiral, has value of a big amount, 41%, I think 50% of yesterday to now And just like it happens thousands of time in the crypto markets, several thing come from gray, temporarily Several things are temporarily reborn. Motived by groups that make a pump and dump scheme. Motivated by this group here on Twitter, the LUNKDAL The group is engaging as many followers as possible to try and predict a return to $ 1 per unit. This does not happen because for the following reason! Today there are 7 trillion tokens Lunaclassic! For it to reach $ 1 it would need 7 trillion dollars in the market. For you have an idea, the biggest bitcoin has only 378 billion! Be careful not to be the last to turn off the lights .
